beats.event: Martians on a dying planet plan an invasion of Earth
A cylinder lands on Horsell Common near narrator's home
Martians incinerate approaching delegation with heat ray
Tripods devastate Woking; narrator hides in ruins
Narrator finds his landlord dead, flees with an artilleryman
Artillery destroys one tripod; Martians briefly retreat
Narrator reaches Walton and takes shelter with a curate
Black smoke chokes towns; London panics and evacuates
HMS Thunder Child destroys three tripods before sinking
Fifth cylinder buries narrator and curate under manor ruins
Watches Martians drain blood from captured humans
Curate goes mad; narrator knocks him out; tentacle takes him
Escapes ruined house; wanders red-weed wasteland
Enters deserted London; finds Martians dead of earth germs
Suffers a nervous breakdown, cared for by strangers
Returns to Woking and reunites with his wife
